EPISODE NUMBER: Episode 1
EPISODE LOGLINE: At her engagement party, Mara learns her fiance has been secretly courting her stepsister, and a quiet stranger in the crowd offers her a contract marriage.
CONTINUITY NOTES: Sample episode written for testing the promo finder. Not real show content.

SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. HOTEL BALLROOM - NIGHT
Scene start: 00:00.00

Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:04.00)
Wide shot of a crowded ballroom as Mara enters in a silver dress, smiling.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:01.00) | End: (00:04.00)
Mara scans the room for her fiance, holding two glasses of champagne.

**MARA (Warm, Hopeful):**
Start: (00:04.50) | End: (00:06.50)
"Has anyone seen Daniel?"

**WAITER (Nervous):**
Start: (00:07.00) | End: (00:09.00)
"He went to the terrace, miss."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:09.50) | End: (00:13.00)
Mara pushes open the terrace door and freezes as she sees Daniel kissing her stepsister Lila.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:10.00) | End: (00:11.50)
Champagne glasses shatter on the stone floor.

**MARA (Shocked, Breathless):**
Start: (00:13.50) | End: (00:15.50)
"Daniel? What is this?"

**DANIEL (Cold, Dismissive):**
Start: (00:16.00) | End: (00:19.00)
"You were never going to find out like this."

**LILA (Smug, Gloating):**
Start: (00:19.50) | End: (00:23.00)
"He chose me months ago, sister. You were just the last to know."

**MARA (Furious, Accusing):**
Start: (00:23.50) | End: (00:27.00)
"You stood next to me at my own engagement and lied!"

**DANIEL (Callous):**
Start: (00:27.50) | End: (00:30.50)
"The engagement is over. Your father already signed the papers."

**MARA (Horrified):**
Start: (00:31.00) | End: (00:33.00)
"What papers?"

**LILA (Mocking, Cruel):**
Start: (00:33.50) | End: (00:37.50)

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:38.00) | End: (00:41.00)
Mara slaps Lila across the face. The guests gasp and turn.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:38.50) | End: (00:39.50)

**DANIEL (Threatening):**
Start: (00:41.50) | End: (00:45.00)
"Touch her again and I will have security drag you out."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:45.50) | End: (00:49.00)
A tall man in a dark suit steps out of the shadows behind Daniel.

**STRANGER (Calm, Deadly):**
Start: (00:49.50) | End: (00:52.00)
"Nobody is dragging her anywhere."

**DANIEL (Alarmed):**
Start: (00:52.50) | End: (00:54.50)
"Who the hell are you?"

**STRANGER (Cold):**
Start: (00:55.00) | End: (00:57.00)
"Someone you owe money to."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:57.50) | End: (01:01.00)
The stranger turns to Mara and holds out a folded contract.

**STRANGER (Quiet, Firm):**
Start: (01:01.50) | End: (01:05.00)
"Marry me for one year, and I give you back everything they took."

**MARA (Stunned):**
Start: (01:05.50) | End: (01:07.50)

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:08.00) | End: (01:12.00)
